The US Navy will be conducting dive operations during the following dates and times. All
support vessels will be monitoring VHF-FM channels 16 and 81A. They will have multiple
boats plus jet skis to deconflict with mariners and provide diver support and protection.
On Thursday (August 13, September 10, October 8, 2026) they will be conducting day into
night dive operations from (0800) to (1159), at Fleming Key Cut and Man of War Harbor.
Divers will be confined to transiting through the cut on only one side, leaving the other
side open. Additionally On Thursday (August 13, September 10, October 8, 2026) they will
be conducting dive operations from (0800-1159) along the Southwest edge of Flemming key
into Key West Harbor, Naval Restricted Area #4. Divers will be no farther from shore than
50m and should pose a minimal obstruction to routine navigational operations. Depending
on the weather and sea state, we may shift operations along the eastern side of Flemming
Key staying west of Key West Harbor Garrison Channel. Divers will be no farther from
shore than 50m and should pose a minimal obstruction to routine navigational operations.
On Monday (August 17,  September 14, October 12, 2026) they will be conducting day dive
operations from (0800) to (1159), in vicinity of Fort Zachery Taylor State Park and Key
West Harbor Channel. Divers will be no farther from shore than 50m and should pose a
minimal obstruction to routine navigational operations. Additionally, divers will remain
less than 25m from shore when parallelling the Key West Harbor Channel. 
 
On Tuesday
(August 18,  September 15,  October 13, 2026) they will be conducting dive operations
from (0800-1159) in vicinity of Star Island (Green Bouy 19), Key West Naval Harbor
Restricted Area #2, Key West Main Channel Lighted Bouy 15. We are splashing divers at Key
West Main Channel Lighted Bouy 15 they are then going to transit along the west side of
Key West Naval Harbor Restricted Area #2. then across the Key West Main Channel to
Daybeacon 2.
 
On Wednesday (August 19, September 16, October 14, 2026) they will be
conducting day into night dive operations from (0800-1159), in Vicinity of Flemming Key
(West and East Side), Flemming Key Cut, Man of War Harbor, Key West Harbor Garrison
Channel, Garrison Bight Channel Inlet, Key West Harbor Channel, and Key West Harbor
Channel Turning Basin.
 
On Thursday (August 20, 2026, September 17, October 15, 2026)
they will be conducting dive operations from (0800-1159) in vicinity of Fort Zachery
Taylor State Park Beach and Key West Harbor Channel. Divers will be no farther from shore
than 50m and should pose a minimal obstruction to routine navigational operations.
Additionally, divers will remain less than 25m from shore when parallelling the Key West
Harbor Channel while heading South and East in between shore and Fort Taylor West
Obstruction Light.
